description:
Each RequestConfig lazily creates its own Cache instance, which:
- Spawns a CacheStore owner fiber
- Registers a cleanup proc with PeriodicCleanup

If many RequestConfig instances are created (one per request), fibers accumulate. No close/dispose method exists.

Fix: Add close/dispose method to RequestConfig that sends stop to CacheStore fiber and unregisters cleanup. Document config reuse.
title: RequestConfig Cache instances spawn permanent fibers never cleaned up
